result.instructions: Tools for GoFormz, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which forms were completed this week for the Safety Inspection template?"; "Show every field value on form 170f4764-293c-4e94-b0b1-6d72ea778825."; "Create a draft Work Order form for Acme and assign it to Maria.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GoFormz data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run goformz_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run goformz_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run goformz_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. goformz_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: goformz_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the form templates of the account (id, name). Use a template id to list its forms or to create a form. GET /v2/templates.

name.description: Only items whose name starts with this text.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: goformz_get_template
tools.title: Get a template
tools.description: Get one template by id. GET /v2/templates/{id}.

tools.name: goformz_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List forms (filled-in instances of templates) with name, status (draft or complete), last update date and assignment. Field values are NOT included: call goformz_get_form for those. Filter by name prefix, status or last-updated date. GET /v2/formz.

name.description: Only items whose name starts with this text.

status.description: Only draft or only complete forms.

updated_after.description: Only forms last updated after this date or date-time (ISO 8601).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: goformz_list_template_forms
tools.title: List forms of a template
tools.description: List the forms created from one template (name, status, last update date). Field values are not included. GET /v2/templates/{templateId}/formz.

name.description: Only items whose name starts with this text.

status.description: Only draft or only complete forms.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: goformz_get_form
tools.title: Get a form
tools.description: Get one form with all its field values (text, numbers, dates, checkboxes, table rows, signature/image references), status, assignment and template version. GET /v2/formz/{id}.

include_deleted.description: Also return a form that has been deleted (default false).

tools.name: goformz_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List user groups (forms can be assigned to a group). GET /v2/groups.

name.description: Only items whose name starts with this text.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: goformz_get_group
tools.title: Get a group
tools.description: Get one group by id. GET /v2/groups/{id}.

tools.name: goformz_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the account's users (id, username, first and last name). A user id is needed to assign a new form. GET /v2/users.

name.description: Only items whose name starts with this text.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: goformz_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by id. GET /v2/users/{id}.

tools.name: goformz_list_datasources
tools.title: List data sources
tools.description: List data sources (lookup tables that feed dropdown and database fields in templates). GET /v2/datasources.

name.description: Only items whose name starts with this text.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: goformz_get_datasource
tools.title: Get a data source
tools.description: Get one data source: its name, columns and indexed columns. GET /v2/datasources/{id}.

tools.name: goformz_list_datasource_rows
tools.title: List data source rows
tools.description: List the rows of a data source. Each row has an id, a keyColumn (the lookup key) and a value (a JSON-encoded array of the column values). GET /v2/datasources/{dataSourceId}/rows.

name.description: Only rows whose key column starts with this text.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: goformz_get_datasource_row
tools.title: Get a data source row
tools.description: Get one data source row by id. GET /v2/datasources/{dataSourceId}/rows/{rowId}.

tools.name: goformz_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks that call a URL when a form of a template is completed (event form.complete). Read-only. GET /v2/webhooks.

template_id.description: Only webhooks for this template (the webhook's entity id).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: goformz_get_queue_item
tools.title: Get an async job status
tools.description: Check a queued job, for example the PDF export started by goformz_export_form_pdf. Returns status (and progressIndicator); when it is Completed, redirectUrl points at the result (a /v2/files/{id} URL: pass that id to goformz_get_file). GET /v2/queue/{id}.

tools.name: goformz_get_file
tools.title: Get a file
tools.description: Get a file summary: type, created date and a temporary download `link` (it expires; see linkExpiration). Use it for an exported PDF or a form image/signature. The file itself is not downloaded here. GET /v2/files/{id}.

tools.name: goformz_get_pdf_export
tools.title: Get a PDF export
tools.description: Get the metadata of a PDF export of a form, including the temporary download `link` once the PDF is ready. GET /v2/formz/{formId}/exports/{exportId}.

tools.name: goformz_export_form_pdf
tools.title: Export a form to PDF
tools.description: WRITE: start a PDF export of a form (the form is not changed; GoFormz creates a PDF file). The reply gives the queue_id of the job: poll goformz_get_queue_item until Completed, then read the file with goformz_get_file using the id in redirectUrl. POST /v2/formz/{formId}/exports.

pages.description: Pages to include, for example "1-5,7,9" (default all pages).

tools.name: goformz_create_form
tools.title: Create a form
tools.description: WRITE: create a new draft form from a template, optionally pre-filled and assigned to a user or group (assignment is only possible at creation). Field keys are the template's field names (or ids) and the values are field objects such as {"text": "Acme"}; see goformz_get_form on an existing form of the template for each field's shape. Each call creates another form. POST /v2/formz.

name.description: Form name. Ignored unless override_default_form_name is true: GoFormz names forms by the template's rule.

override_default_form_name.description: Use `name` instead of the template's automatic form name (default false).

fields.description: Field values keyed by field name or id, for example {"PO #": {"value": "1223333"}, "Customer": {"text": "Acme"}}.

assign_to_type.description: Assign the form to a User or a Group (needs assign_to_id).

tools.name: goformz_update_form
tools.title: Update a form
tools.description: WRITE: change a form's name and/or field values (partial update: only the fields given change; a null value clears a field). Does NOT change the status and does not trigger workflows; to re-run completion workflows use goformz_set_form_status draft, update, then complete. PATCH /v2/formz/{id}.

fields.description: Field values keyed by field name or id, for example {"PO #": {"value": "1223333"}}; null clears the field.

tools.name: goformz_set_form_status
tools.title: Complete or re-open a form
tools.description: WRITE: mark a form complete (this can trigger the template's completion workflows and webhooks) or re-open it as a draft so it can be edited. POST /v2/formz/{id}/status.

status.description: complete to finish the form, draft to re-open it.

tools.name: goformz_create_datasource_row
tools.title: Add a data source row
tools.description: WRITE: add a row to a data source. key_column is the lookup key; values are the column values in the data source's column order (see goformz_get_datasource). Each call adds another row. POST /v2/datasources/{dataSourceId}/rows.

key_column.description: The row's lookup key (the value of the key column).

values.description: Column values in column order, as strings.

tools.name: goformz_update_datasource_row
tools.title: Update a data source row
tools.description: WRITE: replace a data source row's key and values (the whole row is replaced; send every column). PATCH /v2/datasources/{dataSourceId}/rows/{rowId}.

values.description: All column values in column order, as strings.

prompts.title: Get started with GoFormz
